The '''Ghorman heist'''<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|235|Rebel Rouser: The Music of Andor Season 2|Rebel Rouser: The Music of ''Andor'' Season 2}}</ref> was a heist carried out by the [[Ghorman Front]] and [[Axis network]] to steal cargo crates of weaponry from the [[Galactic Empire]],<ref name="WAFE" /> in [[3 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> 

==Prelude==
{{Quote|A smear campaign is an opening move, not an endgame. I need the endgame!|Luthen Rael|<ref name="EBTG" />}}
During 5 BBY,<ref name="5BBY">{{AndorDate|104}}</ref> the [[Galactic Empire]] enacted a [[blockade]] around the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]]. <ref name="Dhani">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}</ref> Senator [[Mon Mothma]] gave a speech against the blockade as news spread of the [[Aldhani heist|heist on Aldhani]]. <ref name="EYE">{{Andor|The Eye}}</ref> In 4 BBY,<ref name="4BBY">{{AndorDate|201}}</ref> [[Dee Shambo]] and [[Nisus Osar]] of the [[Ministry of Enlightenment]] told the secret meeting on the [[Maltheen Divide]] their role in the Blockade. [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]] [[ISB Supervisor|Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] suggested to Director [[Orson Callan Krennic]] that the Empire needed rebels that could be influenced to do what they wanted. <ref name="OYL">{{Andor|One Year Later}}</ref> In 3 BBY,<ref name="Date" />  Undercover agent and ISB Supervisor [[Lonni Jung]] informed [[Luthen Rael]] that Dedra Meero was running Ghorman. At a town meeting, Ghorman locals including [[Lezine]] complained about the noise of the transport carriers at night and the construction of the [[Palmo armory]]. After the meeting Ghorman Front Leader, [[Carro Rylanz]] and his daughter [[Enza Rylanz]] would meet [[Syril Karn]] who had been transferred to the [[Imperial Bureau of Standards]]' office on Ghorman in order to infiltrate the Ghorman Front. Syril Karn gave information about the transport shipments to Carro that would be used for the heist. Following the meeting with Lonni, Luthen sent [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] to meet the Ghorman Front.<ref name="EBTG">{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}}</ref> Upon his arrival, Andor met with Enza Rylanz before being introduced to her father and leader of the Ghorman Front, Carro Rylanz. <ref name="IHFE">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}</ref> Carro informed Cassian they had information given to them by an Imperial informant, whom unbeknownst to Andor, was [[Syril Karn]]. Andor inspected the tunnels at night with members of the Ghorman Front, and Cassian told Carro that after his inspection, the Ghorman Front was not ready. Upon meeting with Luthen, Andor relayed his doubts that the Ghorman Front was not yet ready.<ref name="WAFE" /> 

==The heist==
{{Quote|We're here because you've never done anything like this.|Vel Sartha|<ref name="WAFE" />}}
After Cassian's refusal, Luthen sent [[Vel Sartha]] and [[Cinta Kaz]] to lead the heist instead. Vel and Cinta met and discussed their relationship in the [[Ghorman cafe]] at [[Palmo Plaza]]. During preliminary preparations with the Ghorman Front, Vel and Cinta asserted that no [[blaster]]s should be brought to the heist due to their inexperience. During the Heist, [[Dreena]], who previously argued with Vel and Cinta left her post to help an elderly woman. As the heist concluded, a member of the Ghorman Front, [[Samm]], who brought a blaster against the orders of Vel and Cinta, accidentally shot Cinta, following an argument with Lezine which had escalated, killing her. Unbeknownst to the Ghorman Front and Axis Network, ISB [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz]] and Dedra Meero monitored the heist from the [[Imperial Security Bureau control center]], whilst Syril Karn overlooked the heist from a nearby rooftop and communicated via a [[comm unit]]. After the heist ended, Vel fervently chastised a weeping Samm for Cinta's death.<ref name="WAFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It was really cool and we were looking at trains, and high-speed trains, and what kind of thing, and the guns come in on the trains and hijacking and levels. Oh my god, money, man. Money. Couldn't do it.|Tony Gilroy|<ref name="TrainHeist">{{WebCite|url=https://screenrant.com/andor-cut-ghorman-massacre-robbery-story-tony-gilory-response|text=Cut Ghorman Massacre Story Revealed By Andor Showrunner|author=Abigail Stevens|date=2025-05-19|archivedate=20250522125551}}</ref>}}
According to ''[[Star Wars: Andor|Andor]]'' showrunner [[Tony Gilroy]], originally the heist would be a train robbery, based on a planet-wide rail distribution system that connected to a depot outside of Palmo, but the idea was eventually scrapped due to budget constraints.<ref name="TrainHeist" />
